items.t: GSK (LSE:GSK) Settles Key Vaccine Patent Case And Wins Broad Europe Injunction
items.sum: GSK (LSE:GSK) reached a cross-licensing agreement with Moderna resolving their COVID-19 vaccine patent dispute in Europe. The pharma group secured a significant injunction against Pfizer-BioNTech covering liposome delivery technology used in RNA vaccines across multiple European markets.
